subject.promotion_meaning: frozen measurement contract — the signal definition is locked for continued paper accounting; still paper-only, never a trading authorization, never RLCD/training authorization

evidence_windows.oos_counting_rule: count decision_date >= 2026-09-25 rows of results/forward_ledger_v2.jsonl; the ledger is append-only and idempotent so post-freeze rows are written only from data that did not exist at freeze time

primary_arm.universe: perp_pit_xs_v1, 10 USDT-M perps — the spec's own universe
primary_arm.accounting: 5bps per one-sided leg-unit traded, close basis (mark proxy), day_net_bps summed over decision days including flat days

secondary_arm.universe: perp_pit_xs_v2, 30-asset qvol universe — confirmation arm only; must not contradict (net > 0 over the same window), does not relax primary thresholds

context_window_not_counted.note: refresh-fed decision days outside the T104-T108 measured window but written by backfill after freeze — directional context only, never counted toward min_oos_days

contract_conformance.issue: the live ledger gates on BTC close > SMA20 (financial_forward_ledger_v2.py btc_sma_map; sleeve xs_dfh20_top2_bot2_btc_sma20_gate_v1) while the spec contract gates on BTC close/close[t-20]-1 > 0 (ret20). Measured divergence: the two gate definitions disagree on 211/1363 (15.5%) of xs_v1 decision days and on 2 days (2026-09-09, 2026-09-11) inside the current context window
contract_conformance.resolution_required: either (a) rebuild the forward ledger under the spec's ret20 gate so OOS evidence measures the actual contract, or (b) amend the v2 spec to the SMA20 gate with re-measured in-sample gated stats — no OOS day counts toward this gate until one is done and recorded

require_at_evaluation: probe state file age <= 24h at evaluation time
v2 and v2_xs2 ledgers: latest decision bar age <= 72h (probe default 48h + refresh slack for open-month daily-zip gaps)
last ledger decision_date within 5 calendar days of evaluation
0 input dates missing from either ledger
no persistent skipped_insufficient_universe tail (universe < 6 means the sleeve is flat-by-degradation, not measuring)

concentration_caps.note: worst-week share = |min weekly net| / cumulative net — a single bad week must not erase more than half of accumulated net; best-week share = max weekly net / cumulative net — upside must not be one lucky week (T115 anatomy: 65.6% of PnL from 3 assets was noise, not edge)

comparator_requirements.computed_over: identical OOS decision dates, identical cost model where applicable

vs_ungated_book.definition: same top2/bot2 dfh20 book replayed with the BTC gate forced on
vs_ungated_book.requirement: net_gated > net_ungated (strict) — T106 measured uptrend +111.4bps vs downtrend -13.8bps; a gate that adds nothing OOS is dead weight and the candidate reverts to the ungated null

vs_equal_weight_long.definition: equal-weight long all ranked universe assets, same days, gross (no cost — passive comparator)
vs_equal_weight_long.requirement: gated cumulative net > 0 in EACH subwindow split by EW-long daily sign, provided that subwindow has >= 10 days — the dollar-neutral book must not be market beta in disguise; if one subwindow has < 10 days the check is deferred, not waived

vs_spec_v1_sleeve.definition: results/forward_ledger_v1.jsonl crowded_long_carry_follow_v1 realized net over the same window
vs_spec_v1_sleeve.requirement: both sleeves cumulative net > 0 over the window — they share the same BTC master gate, so simultaneous survival is the sanity check that the shared regime gate still prices correctly; bps magnitudes are not comparable across the two accounting conventions and are not required to cross

promotion_thresholds.secondary_arm_requirement: v2_xs2 cumulative net > 0 over the same OOS window and same-sign mean day net as the primary arm

day_60_checkpoint.demote_if: cumulative net < 0 — half the measured in-sample drift (~13.5bps/day * 60 = +810bps expected) failing to even break even means OOS decay beyond any defensible bound
day_60_checkpoint.action: demote to spec_candidate_under_review; investigate before further accumulation counts

kill_if_any: cumulative net < -800bps (~1.3x the measured full-history worst week of -604.4bps)
OOS book-level spearman(dfh20_rank, next-day close return) < 0 over the window with >= 30 active days — sign flip vs the measured positive cross-sectional effect means the ranked edge inverted
hard_kill_anytime.action: retire to graveyard (TRACK_B §3), requires owner sign-off; the spec is not silently deleted

demote_conditions: ungated book net >= gated book net at evaluation — the load-bearing gate stopped adding value
gate_occupancy outside [0.15, 0.90] sustained >= 20 consecutive decision days — instrumentation break or regime dislocation; pause counting, do not score as signal failure
secondary arm (xs_v2) net < 0 while primary passes — promotion blocked pending explanation; the edge was measured on both universes
kill_demote_branch.infra_pause: ledger staleness > 7 calendar days or missing input dates -> suspend OOS counting until the refresh chain recovers (infra fault, not signal evidence)

evaluation.cadence: checkpoint at oos_day 60; full evaluation at oos_day >= 90 or first date all thresholds are computable
evaluation.evaluator: deterministic recompute over the recorded append-only ledgers (no replay substitution — recorded day_net_bps is the accounting of record); comparator arms replay from the same merged inputs at evaluation time
evaluation.tail_drift_caveat: append-only ledger never rewrites; late-arriving bars reprice recent fills — a spot-check fresh replay of the context window differed from recorded cumulative by ~355bps; evaluation uses recorded rows but reports the replay delta

forbidden_interpretations: promotion is a frozen measurement contract, not a trading authorization
not a profitability or live-trading claim — paper accounting only
not authorization to train RLCD or fit any model on the ledger
thresholds are predeclared and must not be revised post-hoc to fit accumulating evidence; any change requires a new versioned gate file
